maxPosts.title: Max Posts to Scrape
maxPosts.description: Number of top posts to scrape commenters from. Actor will gracefully finish scraping all commenters of the Nth post before exiting.

verificationFilter.title: Commenter Verification Filter
verificationFilter.description: Select whether to scrape verified commenters, unverified commenters, or both.

cookies.title: Session Cookies (JSON or Netscape String)
cookies.description: X.com session cookies. Provide cookie JSON array or cookie strings.

delayBetweenScrolls.title: Delay Between Scrolls (ms)
delayBetweenScrolls.description: Delay in milliseconds between scroll actions inside post comment section.

supabaseUrl.title: Supabase Project URL
supabaseUrl.description: Supabase project URL (overrides SUPABASE_URL env var).

supabaseAnonKey.title: Supabase Anon / Service Key
supabaseAnonKey.description: Supabase API key (overrides SUPABASE_ANON_KEY env var).

browserlessApiKey.title: Browserless API Key (Optional)
browserlessApiKey.description: Optional Browserless.io API key for remote CDP session. If omitted, uses container local Chrome.
